issues.explanation: No test files are included in the diff despite new routes, controllers, mail theme and translations requiring Pest/PHPUnit coverage per TDD.
No docs or CHANGELOG update accompanies the behavior change despite docs-freshness requiring it.
Password update validates three fields inline with complex rules instead of a Form Request once rules grow beyond one or two fields.
Reset form mixes English labels with hardcoded Portuguese Confirmar senha instead of consistent translation keys.
phpunit.xml pins APP_KEY in addition to the three required pins, which the task lists as out of scope.

conventions.evidence: Uses Password broker and standard controllers (good reuse) with PHPDoc and $fillable intact, but ships no tests against TDD rule 'no production code without a test' and updates no docs/CHANGELOG; NewPasswordController.php:95-103 validates 3 fields inline vs Form Request guidance

readability.evidence: Small focused methods (create/store/__invoke) and semantic views with {{ }} escaping and role=status/alert; only flaw is mixed-language label 'Confirmar senha' in reset-password.blade.php:334 vs English __('Email Address')

requirements.evidence: .env.example:7,14 APP_NAME=PegaFila APP_LOCALE=pt_BR; config/mail.php:211 theme=pegafila; pegafila.css:589 button-primary #0f7490; pt_BR.json:229,237 subjects; routes/web.php:664-680 all 5 names with guest+throttle:6,1 and auth+signed+throttle; PasswordResetLinkController.php:164-165 always back with passwords.sent; NewPasswordController.php:98-113 min8 letters/mixedCase/numbers/confirmed + Hash + remember_token + PasswordReset + redirect /; VerifyEmailController.php:42-55 id/hash 403 + redirect /

scope.evidence: All controllers, routes, views, theme CSS, lang entries and User MustVerifyEmail serve the task; only extra is phpunit.xml:249 APP_KEY beyond the three required pins

security.evidence: No weakness found: $request->validate email/token/password everywhere needed; VerifyEmailController.php:42-45 hash_equals(sha1(...)) + abort 403; routes guarded guest and auth+signed+throttle:6,1; views use {{ }} only; User forceFill password + remember_token with #[Fillable]/#[Hidden] intact

simplicity.evidence: Lean direct implementation reusing Password::sendResetLink/reset broker and default mail theme copy with color swap; no service layers, Livewire, layouts or speculative abstractions

tests.evidence: change.diff contains no tests/* or test files; all password-reset and verification paths have happy-path-only code with no Pest/PHPUnit coverage and no unauthorized/tamper tests

review.summary: Delivers the pt-BR password-reset and email-verification flow with correct routes, validation, mail theme and translations. Missing test coverage blocks merging despite correct behavior, with only minor scope and doc nits otherwise.
